tasks.prompt:
We need to complete a real development change in this pinned project. First inspect the actual source and supplied business reproduction, explain the relevant call path and edge cases, and raise any clarification questions. Propose a concrete plan with compatibility and test coverage, and wait for my confirmation before editing. Continue the implementation and any validation fixes in this same conversation and workspace. The following describes the eventual delivery scope, not an instruction to skip investigation or plan agreement:

Now modify this product application to add an `export` subcommand. Use `python shop.py export catalog.json --output result.json` to export the product list as JSON: preserve product order and the sku, name, and quantity fields, ignore other fields, and save Chinese characters as actual characters. The input must be an array of objects, each with non-empty string sku and name fields and a non-negative integer quantity (booleans do not count as integers). Reject duplicate sku values; an empty array is allowed. Invalid JSON or any invalid record must result in a nonzero exit with an explanation, and must not leave a partial export file. Refuse to overwrite an existing output file, and do not modify the input file. Also preserve the existing `product` command, add tests of business behavior, and provide brief usage documentation. Modify only this user application and its tests and documentation; do not change Typer or the dependency environment.

Extend the already delivered app/shop.py product/export application with real import-csv SOURCE --output NEW_JSON. Require exactly sku/name/quantity CSV headers in any order; UTF8/BOM, normal CSV quoted commas/newlines and Unicode supported, integer ASCII nonnegative quantity and unique nonempty sku/name. Validate all rows before publishing canonical three-field JSON in input order; header-only emits []. Preserve original input, refuse existing/symlink/same-path output, use same-directory completed temp+exclusive link so no partial/overwrite race. Add reusable app/inventory_store.py and command-module registration to support subsequent real business commands without replacing delivered product/export. Do not modify Typer library or dependency environment.

Deliver real implementation, original-failing public tests at app/development_tests/test_development_typer_02_dev.py, and English compatibility documentation at app/docs/development-typer-02-dev.md. Preserve frozen original tests, environment and test controls. Only modify authorized paths.
